# Why this run exists

The approved Study 2 network has no measure of accuracy. This post hoc,
exploratory run adds four correction rates from the Study 3 corrector to the 15
approved nodes and re-estimates everything (DECISIONS D54). The approved
notebooks and figures do not change. Community numbering is arbitrary, so compare
membership with `network-analysis.qmd` rather than labels.

```{r}
#| label: drop-parameter
#| code-fold: false

# No predictability node is held out.
drop_var <- NULL

# The four correction rates (nodes.py), with their plot labels.
extra_nodes <- c(correction_mechanics = "Mech", correction_grammar = "Gram",
                 correction_det_prep = "DetPrep", correction_lexical = "LexPhr")
extra_nodes_file <- "data/study3/ellipse/accuracy_network/nodes_corrector.csv"
run_dir <- "results/study3/ellipse/accuracy_network/corrector"
```
